ev.q: In 2021, 6.9% of adults aged ≥18 years rarely or never got the social and emotional support they needed.
bar chart showing the percentage of adults aged ≥18 years who rarely or never get the social and emotional support they need
In 2021, 6.9% of adults aged ≥18 years rarely or never got the social and emotional support they needed.
Overall, the percentage was higher among those with a disability (11.7%) than among those without disability (6.4%).
Among men, 11.3% of those with disability rarely or never got needed support, compared with 7.0% of those without disability.
Estimates are based on household interviews of a sample of the civilian, noninstitutionalized U.S. population.

methods_quotes.q: With 95% CIs indicated by error bars.
